announcement.msg_id: ARA 4.10.3 — Plugin SketchUp 1.11.1: alat baru ARA Clean (periksa & bersihkan model berat: tekstur kebesaran, grup kembar, definisi tak terpakai, garis liar — satu kali Undo), Gambar Kerja dengan daftar perabot untuk dicentang (termasuk group tanpa nama), pintu kabinet yang tidak sejajar kini terbaca, notasi & tebal garis gaya kantor, DXF dengan ukuran asli, dan Export menanyakan folder simpan. Plugin diperbarui otomatis saat ARA dibuka. Mohon perbarui: unduh di github.com/gigihwicaksono09-spec/ARA_AURUM/releases (SmartScreen: More info → Run anyway).
announcement.msg_en: ARA 4.10.3 — SketchUp plugin 1.11.1: new ARA Clean tool (check & clean heavy models: oversized textures, duplicate groups, unused definitions, stray edges — one Undo), Shop Drawings with a tickable furniture list (unnamed groups included), misaligned cabinet doors now detected, office-style notation & line weights, DXF with real dimensions, and Export asks where to save. The plugin updates automatically when ARA opens. Please update: download at github.com/gigihwicaksono09-spec/ARA_AURUM/releases (SmartScreen: More info → Run anyway).
